tests\core\test_stt_scoped_engine.py:285: AssertionError
_ test_real_self_vad_gap_settles_admitted_stable_and_fresh_tail_reaches_source_and_translation _

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_real_self_vad_gap_settles_admitted_stable_and_fresh_tail_reaches_source_and_translation():
        llm = HeldManualProvider()
        transport = FaultTransport()
        async with self_capture_pipeline(transport, llm) as env:
            first_id = await spoken_turn(env)
            await wait_until(lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 1 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[0]))
            first = transport.sockets[0]
            await first.push(native(first.task_ids[0], text="Already admitted A."))
            await wait_until(lambda: env.harness.self_owner.merge_buffer is not None)
            assert env.harness.self_owner.merge_buffer.parts == ["Already admitted A."]
            assert first_id in env.harness.self_owner.runtime.speech_ended_ids
            second_id = await spoken_turn(env, 0.2)
            await wait_until(lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 2 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[1]))
            second = transport.sockets[1]
            await second.push(native(second.task_ids[0], text="UNADMITTED_B"))
            engine = env.factory.engines[0]
            await wait_until(
                lambda: any(turn.pending_update is not None for turn in engine._turns.values())
            )
            await spoken_turn(env, 0.25)
            manual = await env.harness.self_owner.submit_text("Manual independent marker.")
            await asyncio.wait_for(llm.manual_entered.wait(), timeout=1)
            await source_gap(env)
            await wait_until(lambda: all(socket.closed for socket in transport.sockets))
            assert not engine._event_dispatch_task.done()
            await wait_until(lambda: len(terminals(env)) >= 2)
            cancelled = [event for event in terminals(env) if event.outcome == "cancelled"]
            assert {event.identity.segment.segment_id for event in cancelled} == {first_id, second_id}
            assert all(
                not event.included_contributions and not event.recognition_origins
                for event in cancelled
            )
            assert env.guarded.retention_budget.used_bytes == 0
            llm.manual_release.set()
            fresh_id = await spoken_turn(env, 0.3, epoch=2)
            await wait_until(lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 3 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[-1]))
            fresh = transport.sockets[-1]
            await fresh.push(native(fresh.task_ids[0], 1, " Fresh C."))
            await fresh.push(native(fresh.task_ids[0], 2, " Exact tail."))
            await fresh.push(control(fresh.task_ids[0], "task-finished"))
            expected = "Already admitted A. Fresh C. Exact tail."
>           result = await require_final_source(env, expected)
                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

_ test_deferred_pre_gap_update_is_rejected_at_real_consumption_and_fresh_source_progresses[provider] _

monkeypatch = <_pytest.monkeypatch.MonkeyPatch object at 0x0000020FC1AD5010>
held_boundary = 'provider'

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("held_boundary", ["provider", "callback", "consumer", "overflow"])
    async def test_deferred_pre_gap_update_is_rejected_at_real_consumption_and_fresh_source_progresses(
        monkeypatch, held_boundary
    ):
        transport = FaultTransport()
        async with self_capture_pipeline(transport) as env:
            await spoken_turn(env)
            await wait_until(lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 1 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[0]))
            old = transport.sockets[0]
            engine = env.factory.engines[0]
            entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
            if held_boundary in ("provider", "overflow"):
                original = engine._deferred_event_sink
                if held_boundary == "overflow":
                    original_capacity = engine._event_buffer.max_events
                    engine._event_buffer._max_events = 1
    
                async def hold(event):
                    if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnUpdate):
                        entered.set()
                        await release.wait()
                    await original(event)
    
                engine.bind_event_sink(hold)
            elif held_boundary == "callback":
                original = TranslationChannelOwnerCallbacks._publish_self_session_state
    
                async def hold(self, state):
                    if self is env.callbacks and not entered.is_set():
                        entered.set()
                        await release.wait()
                    await original(self, state)
    
                monkeypatch.setattr(
                    TranslationChannelOwnerCallbacks, "_publish_self_session_state", hold
                )
            else:
                original = SelfTranslationChannelOwner.handle_stt_event
    
                async def hold(self, event):
                    if self is env.harness.self_owner and isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnUpdate):
                        entered.set()
                        await release.wait()
                    await original(self, event)
    
                monkeypatch.setattr(SelfTranslationChannelOwner, "handle_stt_event", hold)
            try:
                await old.push(native(old.task_ids[0], text="PRE_GAP_NOT_ADMITTED"))
                await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), timeout=1)
                assert env.harness.self_owner.merge_buffer is None
                if held_boundary == "overflow":
                    await old.push(native(old.task_ids[0], 2, " extra one."))
                    await old.push(native(old.task_ids[0], 3, " extra two."))
                    await wait_until(lambda: bool(engine._event_buffer._retired_epochs))
                before = engine._authority_generation
                await source_gap(env)
                assert engine._authority_generation > before
            finally:
                release.set()
            await engine.wait_for_event_ingress_drain()
            assert env.harness.self_owner.merge_buffer is None
            assert not any("PRE_GAP_NOT_ADMITTED" in call["text"] for call in env.llm.calls)
            assert env.owner.snapshot.effective_active
            if held_boundary == "overflow":
                engine._event_buffer._max_events = original_capacity
            await spoken_turn(env, 0.3, epoch=2)
            await wait_until(lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 2 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[-1]))
            await finish(transport.sockets[-1], "Only fresh admitted source.")
>           result = await require_final_source(env, "Only fresh admitted source.")
                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("held_boundary", ["provider", "callback", "consumer", "overflow"])
    async def test_deferred_pre_gap_update_is_rejected_at_real_consumption_and_fresh_source_progresses(
        monkeypatch, held_boundary
    ):
        transport = FaultTransport()
        async with self_capture_pipeline(transport) as env:
            await spoken_turn(env)
            await wait_until(lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 1 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[0]))
            old = transport.sockets[0]
            engine = env.factory.engines[0]
            entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
            if held_boundary in ("provider", "overflow"):
                original = engine._deferred_event_sink
                if held_boundary == "overflow":
                    original_capacity = engine._event_buffer.max_events
                    engine._event_buffer._max_events = 1
    
                async def hold(event):
                    if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnUpdate):
                        entered.set()
                        await release.wait()
                    await original(event)
    
                engine.bind_event_sink(hold)
            elif held_boundary == "callback":
                original = TranslationChannelOwnerCallbacks._publish_self_session_state
    
                async def hold(self, state):
                    if self is env.callbacks and not entered.is_set():
                        entered.set()
                        await release.wait()
                    await original(self, state)
    
                monkeypatch.setattr(
                    TranslationChannelOwnerCallbacks, "_publish_self_session_state", hold
                )
            else:
                original = SelfTranslationChannelOwner.handle_stt_event
    
                async def hold(self, event):
                    if self is env.harness.self_owner and isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnUpdate):
                        entered.set()
                        await release.wait()
                    await original(self, event)
    
                monkeypatch.setattr(SelfTranslationChannelOwner, "handle_stt_event", hold)
            try:
                await old.push(native(old.task_ids[0], text="PRE_GAP_NOT_ADMITTED"))
                await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), timeout=1)
                assert env.harness.self_owner.merge_buffer is None
                if held_boundary == "overflow":
                    await old.push(native(old.task_ids[0], 2, " extra one."))
                    await old.push(native(old.task_ids[0], 3, " extra two."))
                    await wait_until(lambda: bool(engine._event_buffer._retired_epochs))
                before = engine._authority_generation
                await source_gap(env)
                assert engine._authority_generation > before
            finally:
                release.set()
            await engine.wait_for_event_ingress_drain()
            assert env.harness.self_owner.merge_buffer is None
            assert not any("PRE_GAP_NOT_ADMITTED" in call["text"] for call in env.llm.calls)
            assert env.owner.snapshot.effective_active
            if held_boundary == "overflow":
                engine._event_buffer._max_events = original_capacity
            await spoken_turn(env, 0.3, epoch=2)
            await wait_until(lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 2 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[-1]))
            await finish(transport.sockets[-1], "Only fresh admitted source.")

    @pytest.mark.asyncio

_ test_orderly_retirement_preserves_deferred_terminal_and_consumed_source[close] _

retirement = 'close'

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("retirement", ["close", "idle"])
    async def test_orderly_retirement_preserves_deferred_terminal_and_consumed_source(retirement):
        transport = FaultTransport()
        async with self_capture_pipeline(transport) as env:
            await spoken_turn(env)
            await wait_until(lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 1 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[0]))
            socket = transport.sockets[0]
            engine = env.factory.engines[0]
            entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
            original = engine._deferred_event_sink
    
            async def hold(event):
                if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnTerminal):
                    entered.set()
                    await release.wait()
                await original(event)
    
            engine.bind_event_sink(hold)
            closing = None
            try:
                await finish(socket, "Orderly source conserved.")
                await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), timeout=1)
                if retirement == "close":
                    closing = asyncio.create_task(engine.close())
                    await wait_until(lambda: engine._closing)
                    assert not closing.done()
                else:
                    await env.factory.clock.advance_to(60)
                    await wait_until(lambda: socket.closed)
            finally:
                release.set()
                if closing is not None:
                    await closing
>           await require_final_source(env, "Orderly source conserved.")

_ test_self_successor_stable_waits_for_predecessor_and_merge_preserves_native_order[False] _

prefix = False
monkeypatch = <_pytest.monkeypatch.MonkeyPatch object at 0x0000020FC1F4D160>

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("prefix", [False, True])
    async def test_self_successor_stable_waits_for_predecessor_and_merge_preserves_native_order(
        prefix, monkeypatch
    ):
        harness = compose_translation_test_harness(
            stt=None,
            llm=None,
            osc=RecordingOscQueue(),
            clock=FakeClock(),
            low_latency_mode=True,
            low_latency_awaiting_vad_timeout_s=60,
            low_latency_finalize_wait_ms=500,
        )
        owner = harness.self_owner
        emitted = []
    
        finals = []
        original_transcript = type(owner)._handle_transcript
    
        async def observe_transcript(current_owner, transcript, **kwargs):
            if current_owner is owner and kwargs.get("is_final"):
                finals.append(transcript)
            await original_transcript(current_owner, transcript, **kwargs)
    
        monkeypatch.setattr(type(owner), "_handle_transcript", observe_transcript)
    
        async def sink(event):
            emitted.append(event)
            await owner.handle_stt_event(event)
    
        engine, factory, _sessions = await make_engine("self", sink=sink)
        ledger = PeerAudioSegmentLedger(activation_generation=1, settings=settings("qwen_audio"))
        a_start, _, a_end = segment_events(ledger, start_sample=0, now=0)
        b_start, _, b_end = segment_events(ledger, start_sample=100, now=1)
        try:
            await harness.start()
            await engine.handle_owned_vad_event(a_start)
            a = factory.sockets[0]
            if prefix:
                await a.push(native(a.task_ids[0], 1, " A prefix "))
                await wait_until(lambda: owner.merge_buffer is not None)
                assert owner.merge_buffer.parts == [" A prefix "]
            await engine.handle_owned_vad_event(a_end)
            await owner.handle_vad_event(a_end.event)
            await engine.handle_owned_vad_event(b_start)
            b = factory.sockets[1]
            await b.push(native(b.task_ids[0], 1, " B stable "))
            await b.push(native(b.task_ids[0], 2, " B tail "))
            await engine.handle_owned_vad_event(b_end)
            await owner.handle_vad_event(b_end.event)
            await b.push(control(b.task_ids[0], "task-finished"))
            await wait_until(lambda: any(turn.terminal_ready.done() for turn in engine._turns.values()))
            assert not any(
                event.identity.segment.segment_id == b_start.event.utterance_id for event in emitted
            )
            assert (owner.merge_buffer.parts if owner.merge_buffer is not None else []) == (
                [" A prefix "] if prefix else []
            )
            await a.push(native(a.task_ids[0], 2 if prefix else 1, " A drain "))
            await a.push(control(a.task_ids[0], "task-finished"))
            await wait_until(
                lambda: sum(isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnTerminal) for event in emitted) == 2
            )
            expected_a = " A prefix  A drain " if prefix else " A drain "
            assert owner.merge_buffer.parts == [expected_a, " B stable  B tail "]
            assert [event.text for event in emitted if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnTerminal)] == [
                expected_a,
                " B stable  B tail ",
            ]
>           await wait_until(lambda: len(finals) == 1, timeout=2)

tests\core\test_stt_scoped_engine.py:285: AssertionError
_ test_self_reenable_blocks_retired_qwen_before_build_then_reclaims_before_two_fresh_turns _

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_self_reenable_blocks_retired_qwen_before_build_then_reclaims_before_two_fresh_turns():
        unsafe = ReleasableSocket()
        transport = FaultTransport([unsafe])
        factory = RequestFactory(transport)
        llm = HeldManualProvider()
        async with self_capture_pipeline(
            transport, llm, provider_factory=factory, peer_translation_enabled=True
        ) as env:
            try:
                runtime, handle, old = await require_retired_self(env, unsafe)
                config = env.owner.current_config
                manual = await env.harness.self_owner.submit_text("Manual independent marker.")
                await asyncio.wait_for(llm.manual_entered.wait(), timeout=1)
                blocked = await enable_self(env, config)
                assert not blocked.effective_active
                assert transport.attempts == 1
                assert len(factory.requests) == 1 and len(factory.engines) == 1
                assert handle.provider is None
                assert handle._retired_providers == [old]
                assert old.cleanup_debt == 1 and not unsafe.closed
                assert failed_reclaims(runtime, "self")[-1].event == "provider_reclaim"
                with pytest.raises(ProviderResourceQuarantinedError) as captured:
                    await handle.reclaim_qwen_resources()
                assert captured.value.cleanup_debt == 1 and captured.value.owner_count == 1
                assert captured.value.__cause__ is not None
                assert str(captured.value.__cause__) == "provider_resource_quarantined"
                async with peer_pipeline(env) as peer:
                    await utterance(peer, 0.15)
                    await wait_until(
                        lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 2 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[-1])
                    )
                    await finish(transport.sockets[-1], "Independent Peer source.")
                    await wait_until(lambda: peer_final_sources(env) == ["Independent Peer source."])
                    await wait_until(
                        lambda: any(call["text"] == "Independent Peer source." for call in llm.calls)
                    )
                    assert peer.owner.snapshot.effective_active
                    assert not unsafe.closed
                    llm.manual_release.set()
                    await env.harness.translation_turns.wait_for_idle()
                    assert any(
                        event.type is UIEventType.TRANSLATION_DONE
                        and event.utterance_id == manual.turn_id
                        for event in env.harness.ui_events._queue
                    )
                    unsafe.allow_close = True
                    resumed = await enable_self(env, config)
                    assert resumed.effective_active and unsafe.closed
                    assert old.cleanup_debt == 0 and old not in handle._retired_providers
                    before = len(transport.sockets)
                    await spoken_turn(env, 0.2, epoch=2)
                    await wait_until(
                        lambda: len(transport.sockets) == before + 1
                        and finish_sent(transport.sockets[-1])
                    )
                    first = transport.sockets[-1]
                    await spoken_turn(env, 0.3, epoch=2)
                    await wait_until(
                        lambda: len(transport.sockets) == before + 2
                        and finish_sent(transport.sockets[-1])
                    )
                    second = transport.sockets[-1]
                    assert sum(not socket.closed for socket in (unsafe, first, second)) == 2

    @pytest.mark.asyncio

                )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_healthy_qwen_retained_expiry_stays_owned_until_native_drain_then_two_fresh_turns():
        transport = FaultTransport([])
        factory = RequestFactory(transport)
        async with self_capture_pipeline(transport, provider_factory=factory) as env:
            returning = None
            completed = set()
            try:
                await spoken_turn(env)
                await wait_until(
                    lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 1 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[0])
                )
                old_socket = transport.sockets[0]
                await old_socket.push(native(old_socket.task_ids[0], 1, "Already admitted old."))
                await wait_until(
                    lambda: env.harness.self_owner.merge_buffer is not None
                    and env.harness.self_owner.merge_buffer.parts == ["Already admitted old."]
                )
                runtime, handle, old, request = await expire_healthy_qwen_owner(env)
                assert not old_socket.closed
                assert handle._event_handler_for(provider=old, generation=0) is None
                before = len(factory.requests)
                returning = asyncio.create_task(runtime.handoff_provider(request, start=True))
                await wait_until(lambda: runtime.snapshot.channel_for("self").phase == "building")
                assert not returning.done()
                assert len(factory.requests) == before and transport.attempts == 1
                assert old in handle._retired_providers and old.cleanup_debt == 0
                assert not old_socket.closed
                await old_socket.push(native(old_socket.task_ids[0], 2, " EXPIRED OLD TAIL."))
                await old_socket.push(control(old_socket.task_ids[0], "task-finished"))
                completed.add(old_socket)
                assert (await returning).status == "applied"
                assert old_socket.closed and old.cleanup_debt == 0
                assert old not in handle._retired_providers
                await spoken_turn(env, 0.2)
                await wait_until(
                    lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 2 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[-1])
                )
                first = transport.sockets[-1]
                await spoken_turn(env, 0.3)
                await wait_until(
                    lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 3 and finish_sent(transport.sockets[-1])
                )
                second = transport.sockets[-1]
                assert sum(not socket.closed for socket in transport.sockets) == 2
                for socket, text, tail in (
                    (second, " Fresh B.", " Tail B."),
                    (first, " Fresh A.", " Tail A."),
                ):
                    await socket.push(native(socket.task_ids[0], 1, text))
                    await socket.push(native(socket.task_ids[0], 2, tail))
                    await socket.push(control(socket.task_ids[0], "task-finished"))
                    completed.add(socket)
>               source = await require_final_source(
                    env, "Already admitted old. Fresh A. Tail A. Fresh B. Tail B."
                )
